title: Avoidant Attachment Test: Fearful or Dismissive? (12 Questions)
h1: Avoidant Attachment Test: Fearful or Dismissive?

subtypeRules.notDominant: Avoidance score below 40 does not force an avoidant subtype.
subtypeRules.dismissive: Avoidance score >=40 plus anxiety modifier <=35 and elevated hyper-independence or deactivation.
subtypeRules.mixed: Meaningful avoidance without a clean fearful/dismissive split.

personalization.anxietyModifier: Calculated independently from the avoidance score to distinguish fearful push-pull from lower-anxiety distance.
personalization.repairCapacity: Calculated independently from answers that preserve a clear path back after space or conflict.
personalization.tags: Behavior tags include deactivation, flaw focus, hyper-independence, repair avoidance, clean return, closeness pressure, and push-pull.

methodology.design: scenario-based questions focused on closeness, dependence, support, emotional deactivation, conflict withdrawal, and return to repair
researchBackground: adult attachment research conceptualizing insecurity along anxiety and avoidance dimensions
Brennan, Clark & Shaver (1998) Experiences in Close Relationships framework
